readings_unlabelled.R1: Within one continuous arrangement, the plane of the third-eye stands beside (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism, while limbic drift extends toward the metallic ocean of the earth’s iron core. Beyond them are shallow seas and dreams, followed by cosmic swamp-labyrinths beside armored fish creatures. Further across the same scene appear trance-states and ‘fold-type’ time-anomalies, then crypt-navigation and emergence from the depths. The elements remain in this exact order, joined only by direct spatial relations and continuation. Earlier elements remain nearer one another, later elements extend across the same scene, and nothing else is introduced beyond what was dealt.
